labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports a failure in Rich's tests after a Pygments upgrade, which reads as a bug.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No runnable example, traceback, or Rich version; the failing tests are not named.

items.body:
Thanks for the report. To look into this, we need the actual failing output. Please paste a minimal runnable example or the test names and the assertion output for the failing tests (a shortened excerpt is fine; a gist or attachment works if it is too long). Also include:

- The Rich version (`pip show rich`) and the Pygments version you installed
- The output of `python -m rich.diagnose`

Related earlier report: #3088 (Pygments 2.16.1 test failures). Questions about usage belong in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
